text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Medical oncology consultation to confirm the adjuvant endocrine therapy plan, advise on hot flashes, set the surveillance plan, and advise on genetic assessment
  • Tamoxifen 20 mg daily for at least five years, with questions at every visit about hot flashes, abnormal vaginal bleeding, and leg swelling or breathlessness, and a yearly gynecologic assessment
  • Cancer-related history and examination every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years and a yearly diagnostic mammogram of the left breast; no routine blood tests, tumor markers, or body imaging while she has no symptoms
  • Germline genetic counseling and multigene panel testing for breast cancer diagnosed at 44
  • Lymphedema risk counseling and arm checks at every visit; bone health by calcium and vitamin D from diet and weight-bearing exercise; distress, depression, and anxiety screening at intervals
  • Written survivorship care plan, at least 150 minutes of activity a week, alcohol at or below one drink a day, and her decisions about reconstruction and a prosthesis recorded and respected

resource.title: Audre Lorde synthetic care plan
resource.description: Provide primary care survivorship care for a premenopausal woman of 45 after mastectomy for stage IA hormone receptor-positive breast cancer: monitor adjuvant tamoxifen (vasomotor symptoms, abnormal bleeding, and clot symptoms), surveil the remaining breast with a yearly mammogram and no routine blood tests or body imaging, counsel on lymphedema risk and bone health, screen for distress, arrange the germline genetic assessment missed at diagnosis, and respect her informed decision not to have reconstruction or wear a prosthesis.
